## Current doctoral research

::::::

:::::: {.section-content}

My doctoral research focuses on statistical methods for detecting structural breaks in time series models. I investigate the asymptotic behaviour of residual partial-sum processes in ARMA, ARMAX and multivariate models, including specifications with deterministic trends and unit roots.

My broader interests include asymptotic inference, statistical testing, and applications to economics and finance.
